metadata.scope: Phase 0 / U-004 remediation; baseline dd04f21, candidate 715b5f1

executiveSummary.text: CHANGES_REQUESTED: Checkstyle, ESLint, api-docs recovery, core Phase 0 integration evidence, and DataScope branch tests are real, but T-FILE-1 never performs the claimed second upload, CI does not lock the required Phase 0 suites, and the authoritative acceptance/status documents still conflict. Four additional Low findings cover production static documentation UI exposure, evidence provenance, overclaimed acceptance anchors, and T-DS-1 drift.

dimensions.name: Incremental
dimensions.justification: The candidate closes important implementation gaps but retains three blocking review findings.

dimensions.name: Testing Authenticity
dimensions.justification: Most new tests are valuable, but one key test is false confidence and required suites are not locked.

dimensions.name: Release
dimensions.justification: CI executes lint and broad tests but can silently lose the Phase 0 acceptance suites.

dimensions.name: Configuration
dimensions.justification: The dev API-doc regression is fixed; production still publicly serves the static documentation UI shell.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.justification: Multiple authoritative entrypoints retain contradictory Phase 0 acceptance and status statements.

dimensions.name: Supply Chain
dimensions.justification: New dependency versions are locked with integrity data; artifact provenance remains incomplete.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.justification: No high-risk security delta was found; production documentation surface closure is incomplete.

topRisks.title: T-FILE-1 never performs the claimed second upload
topRisks.summary: The test proves lookup after one upload while production upload always writes a new object and row.

topRisks.title: CI does not lock required Phase 0 suites
topRisks.summary: Broad Maven verify can remain green when either acceptance suite is deleted or undiscovered.

topRisks.title: Authoritative Phase 0 acceptance documents still conflict
topRisks.summary: Global DoD, tasks, plan, README and review gate contradict the candidate phase specification.

detailedFindings.title: T-FILE-1 never performs the claimed second upload

evidence.relevantBehavior: The test uploads once, performs a lookup, and asserts the naturally single row while production upload always writes.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A client uploads the same content twice, creating two objects and rows while the named acceptance test remains green.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: Storage deduplication and instant-upload behavior are falsely reported as complete.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Implement scoped deduplication and real sequential/concurrent second-upload tests, or retire the requirement through R10.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Use server-computed strong digests, authorization-scoped reuse, unique idempotency and reconciliation.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Assert two real attempts preserve one authorized file ID, DB row and object, including concurrency.

detailedFindings.title: CI does not lock required Phase 0 suites
detailedFindings.affectedArea: GitHub Actions and Maven test discovery

evidence.relevantBehavior: The workflow performs broad verification without post-validating Phase00 or DataScope XML and testcase sets.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: The target test is renamed outside plugin discovery and hundreds of unrelated tests keep CI green.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: A Phase 0 regression can merge without the required acceptance test running.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Delete stale reports, run clean verify, and parse fresh XML for exact suites, counts, cases and candidate SHA.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Use a machine-readable phase gate manifest and CI-generated evidence artifact.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Exercise missing, stale, renamed, skipped and incomplete XML against the gate.

detailedFindings.title: Authoritative Phase 0 acceptance documents still conflict
detailedFindings.affectedArea: Global DoD, tasks, current plan, README and review gate

evidence.relevantBehavior: It still says Checkstyle and ESLint are not implemented while the candidate and CI implement them.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: Different contributors follow contradictory active instructions and either duplicate WS-6 work or skip the Phase 0 review.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: The project cannot determine its true phase status or acceptance baseline from required entrypoints.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Synchronize all active entrypoints and narrow WS-6 to the genuinely remaining work.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Generate human documentation from one machine-readable phase state and capability source.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Add a documentation consistency check for phase status, package manager and active quality gates.

detailedFindings.title: Production still publicly serves the Knife4j static UI

evidence.relevantBehavior: All profiles permit static documentation paths and the locked UI JAR contains doc.html.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: An external production request obtains the Knife4j UI shell and assets despite the configuration claiming no trial UI.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: Production exposes unnecessary technology fingerprinting and violates its stated environment contract.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Deny all documentation paths in prod and add negative profile tests.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Make documentation UI a non-production optional dependency controlled by one validated property.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Assert prod returns 403 or 404 for doc.html, webjars, Swagger and api-docs while dev remains positive.

detailedFindings.title: Candidate evidence lacks immutable provenance

evidence.relevantBehavior: The artifact omits complete logs, raw XML, candidate SHA, hashes, target markers and exit metadata.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A later local run overwrites target XML while the old hand-written counts remain in Git.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: Reviewers cannot independently attribute the green evidence to a candidate and environment.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Archive complete redacted logs, XML and a SHA-256/candidate/target manifest generated by the gate.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Publish CI provenance artifacts and render documentation summaries from them.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Fail evidence validation on any hash, suite, testcase, time-chain, target or candidate mismatch.

detailedFindings.title: Three 10-of-10 checklist anchors overstate their evidence

evidence.relevantBehavior: Exact checklist items are marked complete using equivalent, sampled or historical rather than direct evidence.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: An exact dev Compose, newly documented parameter or login-route regression escapes because the checklist remains fully checked.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: The next reviewer cannot tell which acceptance statements are directly proven.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Provide exact evidence or narrow each statement and label evidence type and limits.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Bind machine-readable checklist items to gate artifacts and last successful candidate SHA.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Add exact Compose smoke, fresh-schema key matrix and current browser login-route E2E.

detailedFindings.title: T-DS-1 specification and test layer remain misaligned

evidence.relevantBehavior: The spec says equals and ALL, while the test uses IN and SCHOOL and calls only the handler.

detailedFindings.failureScenario: A mapper loses its annotation or alias integration while the isolated handler tests remain green.
detailedFindings.userVisibleImpact: A real list query can lose data-scope filtering despite the Phase 0 unit gate.
detailedFindings.minimalFix: Update the authoritative wording through R10 and add a real mapper/interceptor SQL integration.
detailedFindings.betterLongTermFix: Build a parameterized data-scope integration matrix across types, aliases and pagination.
detailedFindings.regressionTestSuggestion: Capture final mapper count/data SQL and results for COLLEGE, SCHOOL, SELF, NONE and empty scopes.

fixOrder.reason: The phase currently reports an untested and apparently unimplemented product contract as complete.
The new acceptance tests must not be able to disappear while CI stays green.
The original U-004 source-of-truth defect must be closed before Phase 0 can pass.

quickWins.impact: Restores one authoritative Phase 0 baseline and state.
Makes the Phase 0 acceptance suites mandatory in CI.
Closes the remaining production documentation surface.
